notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
evil-winrm provides an interactive PowerShell shell over WinRM (port 5985 HTTP / 5986 HTTPS) with additional pentest features: file upload/download, in-memory script loading, and pass-the-hash support.

=== CHAINING ===
Discover WinRM open (nmap-winrm-scan) → obtain credentials (from LDAP, SMB, spray) → evil-winrm → enumerate local system → privesc → lateral movement.

=== vs ALTERNATIVES ===
evil-winrm is preferred over standard PowerShell Remoting because it doesn't require a Windows client and provides built-in upload/download. wmiexec.py uses WMI instead of WinRM, useful when WinRM is disabled.

=== DETECTION ===
WinRM connections create Event 4624 (logon) on target. Process ancestry: wsmprovhost.exe parent for all evil-winrm commands. Port 5985/5986 connections from unusual sources flagged by EDR.
